posts.text: Two years ago, my colleagues and I were sued by Stephen Miller's America First Legal. The Hines v Stamos case — built atop a number of false allegations — was a central element of the "censorship industrial complex" myth. Today, that case was dismissed (by a Trump judge in LA). We won.

For months, Trump hinted at a connection between his electoral priorities and disaster aid.

That's ... not how this is supposed to work.
